content.title: Calculators page header opens Open Account
content.intent: Prove that the bank header is present on the Calculators page and that its Open Account link navigates to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`.
content.technique_notes: Used equivalence partitioning over the two named site areas and selected the only outcome-changing navigation path the source states. State-flow techniques were applicable to the click-through navigation, but no additional branches or failure modes were specified. No combinatorial coverage was needed because the path has no independent input dimensions; budget max_pairs=3 did not constrain this scenario set.

content.title: Header is present on the Open Account page
content.intent: Prove that the persistent bank header appears on the Open Account page.
content.technique_notes: Used equivalence partitioning over the named page surfaces and isolated the Open Account page presence check because the source states presence on both pages but only specifies navigation from Calculators to Open Account. Negative, boundary, a11y, responsiveness, and i18n techniques were not minted because the evidence makes no promise in those families. No combinatorial coverage was needed because the path has no independent input dimensions; budget max_pairs=3 did not constrain this scenario set.

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Highest value because it covers the only explicit navigation outcome in the source and failure here would block movement between the site's two main areas.
[value_score] Lower value than s1 because it covers static presence only, but it is still required to exercise the explicit cross-page header presence promise on the Open Account page.
